name: press-sound
title: Press Sound
author: Eduardo Retana
description: tap, tick, and pop on press. The cues come from ui-sounds, and mute is the same shared store.

docs: Facade over ui-sounds (cuelume@0.2.4, MIT). tap maps to tap, tick to select, and pop to toggle with strong emphasis. Mute is the shared ui-sounds store and still writes the legacy retana-press-muted key. Nothing plays before a user gesture. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
